verdict.rationale: Asana documents its own automation features: rule actions, rules that app components can attach to, and AI Studio "powerful no-code automations." Partner integrations also fire from Rules (e.g. PagerDuty). These event-driven rules can handle routine team work. However, no evidence shows schedule-based or time-recurring triggers, and the rules functionality itself is only thinly described. Missing for 10: documented schedule/cron or recurring-time triggers, in-depth docs on rule trigger types and configuration, hands-on corroboration.
